text: Song of ascensions to David. Unless Jehovah was to us, now shall Israel say,
Unless Jehovah was to us in the rising up of man against us,
Then they swallowed us down living, in the kindling of their anger against us:
Then the waters overflowed us, the torrent passed over our soul:
Then the swelling waters passed over our soul.
Blessed be Jehovah, who gave us not a prey to their teeth.
Our soul as a sparrow was delivered from the snare of the fowlers: the snare was broken and we were delivered.
Our help is in the name of Jehovah; he made the heavens and the earth.
